description: This file defines an ASP.NET Core API controller named AuthController that manages user authentication-related endpoints including registration, login, and retrieving current user profile.

classes.name: AuthController
classes.description: Controller handling authentication-related endpoints such as user registration, login, and profile retrieval.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Handles user registration by accepting registration data and creating a new user via the IUserService.

methods.name: Login
methods.description: Authenticates a user with provided credentials and returns a JWT token if successful.

methods.name: Me
methods.description: Retrieves the profile information of the currently authenticated user based on the JWT claims.
